title: Panels changed by a clip-path wipe between two video buffers
summary: Two double-buffered media layers (canvases standing in for `<video>`): the hidden one holds the next clip, then opens over the visible one from `clip-path: inset()` in `1 s expo.inOut` (reversed going back) with a 1 px glowing seam written by the same tween; copy out `.34 s power2.in` before the gate, in `.72 s power3.out`; stepped wheel, swipe, keys and buttons from the section switcher; `.2 s` cross-fade and parked first frames under reduced motion; README shows the `<video>` swap and preload
variants: directional inset wipe with a 1 px glowing seam, 1 s expo.inOut, reversed going back (this, default)
opposed-origin scaleY pair: outgoing scaleY → 0 from the top, incoming 0 → 1 from the bottom, 1.5 s, over a greyscale twin
WebGL composite of the two frames when the edge must be shaped by a texture (gl-rtt-composite-transition)
